snippet.title: Hiyah GO! Beta Trailer – Voice-Controlled Battle Royale
snippet.description:
Your voice is your weapon. Welcome to Hiyah GO!, a fast-paced monster battle royale where every spell is cast by speaking out loud.

Game : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4237080/Hiyah_Go

Drop into a chaotic arena, command your squad of powerful creatures, and outplay rival summoners using real-time voice spellcasting. Shout, whisper, or chant your commands — the arena listens, and only the strongest will survive.

🔥 SHOUT YOUR SPELLS
Speak to attack, defend, and unleash powerful abilities. Surprise enemies with perfectly timed voice commands and turn the tide of battle with your own words.

🐲 COMMAND YOUR MONSTERS
Each monster has unique skills and playstyles. Build deadly synergies with agile attackers, tanky guardians, or sneaky tricksters to dominate the arena.

⚔️ SURVIVE THE ARENA
Fast, intense matches where the battlefield keeps shrinking. Move, dodge, summon, and strike — adapt quickly or get eliminated. Only one summoner earns the crown.

🎨 CUSTOMIZE & COLLECT
Unlock and show off your style with:

Monster skins

Player skins

Visual effects

Fun voice-powered emotes

Collect, customize, and stand out in every match.

🔁 A NEW BATTLE EVERY MATCH
Dynamic loot, changing zones, and endless monster combinations make every game feel fresh. Experiment, improve, and climb your way to victory.

🎙️ PLAY WITH YOUR VOICE
Hiyah GO! introduces an innovative voice-driven spellcasting system that puts you directly in the action. No buttons for spells — just your voice.

✨ FEATURES

Voice-controlled spellcasting

Fast-paced battle royale gameplay

Unique monster roster

Strategic squad combat

Unlockable cosmetics & rare skins

Dynamic shrinking arenas

Competitive and endlessly replayable matches

👉 Wishlist / Follow / Join the community and be part of the next evolution of battle royale!
